releases.notes:
## Minor Changes
- Updated Echo Bud and Echo Cluster textures to stand out more against Amethyst Buds and Clusters.
- Echo Buds and Clusters now have unique textures when placed on top of a Calibrated Sculk Catalyst.

## Major Changes
- Added a config menu via MidnightLib. Various features, such as max sickle damage, soul lunge velocity, and umbra vault warden spawning, can now be configured there.
- Tweaked the Ancient Alter world-gen, so they spawn twice as often.

## New Additions
- Added a creative mode tab, which can be turned off in the config.
- Added Sculk Resonator, a new Sculk Sensor variant that can only track resonance vibrations, allowing for easier wireless redstone setups.
- Added an included Consistant Echo Cluster resource pack, which readds the pre-1.2.0 Echo Cluster textures.
- Added an included Alternate Bladed Hook resource pack, which retextures the Bladed Hook item texture.

releases.notes:
## Minor Changes
- Added a new damage type tag, "wont_reset_sickle". As the name suggests, damage types in this tag won't reset the sickle's attack damage.
- Adjusted various block and item models slightly.
- Added Echo Arrows to the Umbra Vault's rare loot table.
- Fixed Hemostasis' sounds not playing.

## New Additions
- Added Calibrated Sculk Catalysts, Echo Buds, and Echo Clusters. Instead of spreading sculk when a mob dies in an 8 block radius, it will instead slowly grow an Echo Cluster.. If the Echo Cluster is fully grown when a mob is slain, it will instead spawn an Echomite.
- Added Echomites. Echomites are slightly slower and tankier Silverfish/Endermite variants that are able to disable shields.
- Added Echo Arrows. They dont do any extra damage, but mobs hit with it will release a sonic boom, damaging any nearby mobs.

mods.description: Adds more uses for Sculk and Echo Shards

releases.notes:
## Minor Changes
- The Sickle's tooltip now shows how much bonus damage it deals on hit.
- Tweaked Soul Lunge's particles slightly.

## Major Changes
- Removed Sickle Enchantments from the Enchantment Table, moving them into the Umbra Vault.
- Removed Bladed Hook from Ancient City Ice Box chests, moving it into the Umbra Vault.
- Rebalanced the Sickle. You can no longer spam-click to gain attack damage, but item cooldowns reduce the Sickle's damage boost by 1/4th instead of nullifying it entirely.
- Completely reworked the Repulse enchantment. It no longer knocks mobs back when damaged but instead retains a large amount of sculk when hit, at the cost of a cooldown. It can be used with other Sickle enchantments, and even buffs Echo Chamber, allowing it to retain sculk, at the cost of a longer cooldown.

## New Additions
- Added 2 new advancements! One for opening an Umbra Vault, and the other for reaching the max damage cap of the Sickle.
- Added Warden Keys, which can appear in Ancient City chests. They appear just about as often as Echo Shards.
- Added the Umbra Vault, a new Vault variant that, when opened, will spawn a Warden (depending on difficulty and the Warden Spawning gamerule). As a tradeoff, it can be used as often as you like, assuming you have enough Warden Keys.
- Added the Ancient Altar, a new small structure that houses an Umbra Vault at its center. There are 4 variants of the structure!
- Added Hemostasis, a new Sickle Enchantment. When right-clicking while the sickle has sculk, you will heal 4 health.
